title: On Evaluating the damage after every storm
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：evaluate　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 evaluate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the headmaster ① evaluated the damage after every storm without complaint, and every student in the school said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the headmaster ② evaluates the damage after every storm with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ evaluate the damage after every storm at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ evaluated the damage after every storm before — a line in the record for October 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Evaluating the damage after every storm without complaint, the headmaster said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ evaluate the work without fear or favour with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Evaluate the work without fear or favour at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new student from the next school ⑧ evaluates the work without fear or favour without complaint every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ evaluated the damage after every storm again when nobody else would.

⑩ To evaluate the damage after every storm, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the school remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the school forgets, somebody evaluates the damage after every storm with great care again and somebody must evaluate the damage after every storm without complaint all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。

B. v. 评估（一般现在 evaluates the damage after every storm：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）

evaluate 意为“评估”，自那以后校长小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 evaluates。
evaluate 意为“评估”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯评估每次风暴过后估一次损失”，此处为不定式 to evaluate the damage after every storm。
evaluate 意为“评估”，学籍册里 十月 那行字说明早在 1974 年之前就有人评估过，故用过去完成时 had evaluated。
evaluate 意为“评估”，校长说“评估每次风暴过后估一次损失这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 evaluating the damage after every storm 作主语。
evaluate 意为“评价”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去评价不偏不倚地评价这件作品”，should ever 之后用原形 evaluate the work without fear or favour。
evaluate 意为“评价”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻评价不偏不倚地评价这件作品（evaluate the work without fear or favour at once），以后再也不要提起。
evaluate 意为“评估”，新来的学生每个学年都照例评价不偏不倚地评价这件作品，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 evaluates。
evaluate 意为“评估”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地评估每次风暴过后估一次损失，用一般过去式 evaluated 叙述。
evaluate 意为“评估”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要评估每次风暴过后估一次损失，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和学堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 evaluate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the headmaster evaluated the damage after every storm without complaint, and nobody in the school forgot it.
Even now the headmaster evaluates the damage after every storm with great care whenever the school asks.
Evaluating the damage after every storm without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever evaluate the work without fear or favour with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next school evaluates the work without fear or favour without complaint every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother evaluated the damage after every storm again, and the school remembered that half.
